business_scope.primary_industry_name: Dangerous Goods UN38.3 Drop Testing and CE-RED Electromagnetic Lab

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Spain-China Agreement for the Promotion and Reciprocal Protection of Investments (2005)
European Union Treaties (including EU-China Comprehensive Agreement on Investment, as applicable)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo; Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo; Real Decreto 609/2023, de 11 de julio (creating the Central Register of Ultimate Beneficial Owners); Orden JUS/319/2018 (forms for UBO registration).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing of any foreign corporate shareholder/parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registro Mercantil Central (Spain) or equivalent foreign company registry

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney for the incorporator or legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national ID of each director and substantive shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National Passport Office or Civil Registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization (if non-Hague state)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of registered office address (e.g., recent utility bill or lease agreement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company or landlord, duly notarized

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, and UBOs against the OFAC-SDN list, UN Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the Spanish Ministry of Economy and Digital Transformation sanctions database. For Legally Unqualified Low_Risk_Standard (hardware testing lab), a baseline KYC is required; PEP status triggers enhanced due diligence in accordance with Article 29 of Ley 10/2010.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central – 'Sección de Denominaciones' (online via the official portal 'regsol' or through the Mercantile Registry agents at www.registradores.org)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be composed exclusively of letters, numbers, dashes, or ampersand characters from the Spanish or Latin alphabet; the name must be in Spanish or any other official EU language if written in Latin script. Non-Spanish names must be transliterated into phonetically acceptable Spanish form; names must not be identical or similar to an existing registered name. The use of 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' or 'SL' as a token is mandatory in the final corporate name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name is rejected by the Central Mercantile Registry, the applicant may file a written appeal (recurso de alzada) before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública of the Ministry of Justice, within one month of the rejection notice. A new name certificate may also be requested immediately; rejection does not preclude resubmission of an alternative name. The name certificate is valid for 3 months from issuance and must be used in the incorporation deed before expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for initial administrative set-up; however, a virtual office is not sufficient as the sole registered office for an ISIC 7120 testing laboratory, since statutory professional liability, physical inspections, and laboratory accreditation require an on-site operational address under Spanish law.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (70% risk) – given the laboratory scope involving dangerous goods and CE-RED electromagnetic testing, the Spanish Ministry of Industry and the competent regional authority are likely to conduct an unannounced inspection of the registered facility after incorporation.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance certificate (certificación negativa de denominación)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official tariff (Orden JUS/399/2016) – fee varies with number of denominations requested

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notary fee for incorporation deed (escritura de constitución)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Collegiate notarial tariff (Real Decreto 1426/1989) – scale proportional to capital and number of incorporators
Statutory registry fee per the Commercial Registry Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública (Ministry of Justice)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No filing fee – mandatory online submission under Real Decreto 609/2023

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark – fixed fee for SL incorporation in Spain, EUR 700–1,200

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and document legalization for foreign corporate parent documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Hague Apostille Authority (Ministry of Foreign Affairs, country of origin)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Spanish Capital Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital, approved by Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, as amended): Articles 4 (minimum capital), 11-19 (incorporation and form of the public deed), 20-23 (registered office), 22-23 (company name), 62-65 (contributions), 209-231 (board of directors and administrators); complemented by the Commercial Registry Regulations (Real Decreto 1784/1996) and Ley 14/2013 on support for entrepreneurs and internationalization (NIE requirements).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry) for name certification and the competent Registro Mercantil Provincial of the Province of the registered office for definitive registration of the company.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (public incorporation deed) executed before a Spanish Notary Public, followed by presentation for registration (inscripción) in the Registro Mercantil Provincial.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Standard SL requires a minimum capital of EUR 3,000, fully subscribed and paid up at incorporation (Article 4.1 LSC); alternatively, a 'Sociedad Limitada de Formación Sucesiva' (SLFS) may be formed with EUR 1 pursuant to Article 4.2 LSC, subject to profit-distribution and liquidation-quota restrictions until the EUR 3,000 threshold is reached. Cash contributions must be deposited in a Spanish credit institution in the company's name and evidenced by a certificate of deposit issued to the Notary; in-kind contributions require a sworn expert valuation report under Article 70 LSC. No state-run escrow account is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: FIRST, that the subscription and allotment of one hundred percent of the company's share capital to the founding members, as reflected in the certificate of deposit, is hereby ratified. SECOND, that the statutory registered office and domicile is adopted at [Street], [Postal Code], [Province], Spain, and all notifications and service of process shall be made at such address. THIRD, that [Full Name(s)] is/are appointed as Administrador Único (Sole Administrator) of the Company, with all powers conferred by the bylaws and applicable law. FOURTH, that the Administrator is expressly authorized to execute filings before the Registro Mercantil and AEAT, open bank accounts, register the Company with the Seguridad Social, and apply for the laboratory licenses required for the ISIC 7120 testing business. FIFTH, this resolution takes full effect upon execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Negative Name Certification from the Central Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry), online via the electronic office or in person in Madrid
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Founders request a Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social, submitting up to three proposed names in Spanish with no identical or confusing similarity to existing registered corporate names. The application must be signed by all founders or their attorney-in-fact; a digital certificate allows fully online submission. The certification has a statutory validity of three months (renewable) and must remain in force on the date the notarial deed is executed.
required_dossiers: Application form for name certification (Solicitud de Certificación)
Copy of each founder's passport or NIE card
List of up to three alternative Spanish-language company names
Digital certificate or authenticated power of attorney for the submitting founder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preferred name is refused due to similarity, the same application can automatically shift to the first available alternative name; the applicant may immediately resubmit with a new set of names accompanied by an additional registry tariff payment without losing priority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit Share Capital and Obtain Bank Certificate of Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution supervised by the Banco de España
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founders open a provisional bank account in the exact proposed corporate name and deposit at least EUR 3,000 (or EUR 1 where the SLFS regime is chosen). The bank issues a certificado de depósito identifying the account holder, account number, and deposited amount, to be attached to the public deed. Alternatively, the notary may certify a cash contribution tendered directly before him, but the bank certificate route is the market-standard and preferred by the Registro Mercantil.
required_dossiers: Negative name certification (in force)
Draft bylaws (estatutos) for account opening compliance
NIE or passport copies of each founder or attorney-in-fact
Public power of attorney if a founder is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires a public power of attorney for non-resident founders, execute an apoderamiento before a Notary Public or Spanish Consulate before opening the account; if the account cannot be opened in the provisional corporate name, the deposit may be made by means of a banker's draft issued to the company in formation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the Public Incorporation Deed before a Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notario) of the province of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: All founders or their duly authorized attorneys must appear before the Notary with original identification documents. The Notary verifies capacity, identity, and the legality of the bylaws, and authorizes the Escritura Pública de Constitución. The deed must include: founder identity and subscription of participations; certificate of deposit or valuation report for in-kind contributions; the estatutos (corporate purpose explicitly covering testing and analysis activities under ISIC 7120, registered office, fiscal year, governing bodies); and appointment of the administration organ. The Notary issues the first copy (primera copia) required for tax and registry filings.
required_dossiers: Certificado Negativo de Denominación in force
Certificate of bank deposit or banker's draft
Original passports/NIEs of all founders
Draft by-laws (estatutos)
Expert valuation report for any in-kind contributions
Criminal record certificates for proposed administrators if required by the Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary identifies formal defects, the deed is corrected and re-executed without loss of the name certification validity; if a foreign founder lacks an NIE, obtain the NIE via Form EX-15 at a Spanish Consulate or the National Police before the notarial appointment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pay Transfer Tax (AJD) and Register the Company at the Provincial Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Consejería de Hacienda of the Autonomous Community (AJD self-assessment) and the Registro Mercantil Provincial of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within thirty working days of execution, self-assess Actos Jurídicos Documentados (modelo 600) on the first copy of the deed, at the rate applicable in the autonomous community (generally 0.75%-1% of the nominal capital). Within two months of the deed date, submit the first copy of the deed for registration at the Registro Mercantil Provincial together with proof of AJD payment. The registry issues a formal inscripción (registration), which is the company's legal foundation as a mercantile entity.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public incorporation deed
Modelo 600 (AJD) payment receipt
Certificado Negativo de Denominación
Proof of payment of municipal capital gains/land tax if applicable to the leased office
Modelo 036 preliminary tax census form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a suspension, supply the missing documents within the granted period; if a refusal (calificación negativa) is issued, the applicant may appeal before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública or remedy the defect by a corrective notarial act and re-file within the legal priority window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Provisional and Definitive Tax Identification Number (NIF) and Complete Tax Census Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), provincial delegation of the registered office, via its electronic office or in-person appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within thirty days of deed execution, submit Modelo 036 to obtain the provisional NIF (beginning with 'B'). Once the Registro Mercantil inscribes the deed, present the registry certificate to obtain the definitive NIF. On the same Modelo 036, the company registers for: (i) Impuesto sobre Actividades Económicas (IAE epígrafe 841 – technical testing and analysis laboratories), (ii) IVA (periodic VAT returns), and (iii) employer withholding tax obligations. The definitive NIF is a precondition for operating bank accounts, invoicing, and hiring.
required_dossiers: Copy of the registered deed or registry presentation slip
NIE of the legal representative/administrator
Public power of attorney of the fiscal representative if applicable
Completed Modelo 036
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT withholds the NIF pending registry completion, attach the registry presentation receipt (justificante de presentación); if the representative lacks an electronic certificate, request a cita previa in person at the AEAT office. Any refusal may be cured by formal complaint (recurso de reposición) within one month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register as Employer with Social Security and Legalize Corporate Books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS) and the Registro Mercantil Provincial
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: With the definitive NIF, file Modelo TA.6 to register the company as an employer (inscripción de empresa) and obtain the Código de Cuenta de Cotización (CCC) before recruiting any personnel. In parallel, the company must obtain official corporate books (Libro de Actas, Libro Registro de Socios and Libro Registro de Participaciones) and legalize them, together with the accounting books (diario, inventarios y cuentas anuales), at the Registro Mercantil, either physically or through the electronic legalization service of the Spanish Official State Gazette.
required_dossiers: Definitive NIF (CIF) of the company
Registration certificate from the Registro Mercantil
Modelo TA.6 employer registration form
Corporate resolution appointing the representative for social-security filings
Corporate books and accounting books in the officially approved format
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the TGSS assigns an incorrect economic-activity code, file the rectification through the RED system; if book legalization is rejected for formal defects, obtain corrected books in the mandatory official format and re-submit within the next registry office hours without additional substantive fees.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Consejería de Industria, Comercio y Empleo of the relevant Autonomous Community (industrial establishment registry) and the municipal licensing department (Ayuntamiento) of the registered office; technical accreditation by Entidad Nacional de Acreditación (ENAC).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Apertura y Actividad (classified municipal operating license) plus laboratory accreditation as a testing laboratory under UNE-EN ISO/IEC 17025 for UN38.3 battery safety testing and CE-RED electromagnetic compatibility testing; where applicable, an Autorización de Industria or registration in the Autonomous Community's Registro de Establecimientos Industriales.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Consejería de Medio Ambiente of the Autonomous Community, coordinated with the Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITECO) for cross-border or transboundary impacts, and the municipal environmental service.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: The laboratory is not subject to a full Environmental Impact Assessment under Annex I of Ley 21/2013; it falls within the simplified-regime categories requiring prior environmental communication or registration (Licencia ambiental simplificada / autorización ambiental unificada) depending on the Autonomous Community and on the storage quantity of dangerous goods (damaged lithium batteries). A municipal noise and vibration certificate and urban-planning compatibility report are mandatory.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges to the municipal sewer must comply with Real Decreto 849/1986 (Reglamento del Dominio Público Hidráulico) and the municipal sewer bylaws: pH 5.5-9.5, suspended solids <500 mg/L, BOD5 <300 mg/L, COD <750 mg/L. VOC exhaust-air emissions, where the laboratory uses solvents or testing atmospheres, must comply with Real Decreto 1042/2017 (Conservation and HFC/VOC regulation) emission limit values of 100 mg C/Nm3 for waste gases and 150 mg C/Nm3 for fugitive emissions when applicable. Damaged or tested lithium cells are hazardous waste under Ley 7/2022; storage on site is capped at 6 months, must be in UN-approved packaging, and must be tracked via the Waste Online Information System (e-SIR or regional equivalent) with final transfer to an authorized waste gestor.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-protection certification issued by the municipal technical service or fire brigade in accordance with Real Decreto 513/2017 (fire-safety installation regulation) covering extinguishers, fire hydrants, emergency lighting, evacuation routes, and fire-resistance of the drop-test enclosure; structural load certificate for the drop tower and heavy equipment verified by a competent engineer; occupational risk prevention plan and health surveillance under Ley 31/1995; specific training and protective equipment for high-energy battery puncture, crush, and impact tests; prior notification of workplace opening (comunicación de apertura) to the Inspección de Trabajo y Seguridad Social; and, if applicable, dangerous-goods storage declaration and compliance with Real Decreto 656/2017 (establishments with dangerous substances).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) — Sede Electrónica: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a newly incorporated Spanish SL, the company obtains its definitive NIF (CIF) as part of the notarial incorporation and commercial registry filing; the legal representative must submit Modelo 036/037 to AEAT for tax registration, including VAT (NIF-IVA) activation. A non-resident company without Spanish establishment engaging in taxable activities must apply for a NIF-NIE via a Spanish tax representative using Modelo 036 and complete the corresponding census registration prior to invoicing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not recognize US-style check-the-box elections. A Spanish SL is a resident entity taxed at corporate level under Ley del Impuesto sobre Sociedades; it may elect to join a Spanish consolidated tax group (grupo fiscal) for corporate income tax under articles 57 et seq. Ley 27/2014, provided common-shareholding thresholds are met. No hybrid mismatch elective classifications exist for ordinary SL entities.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (IVA — Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No Euro-denominated economic threshold; any person or entity engaging in business or professional activities subject to VAT is required to register with AEAT before commencement. Simplified and special regimes (e.g. recargo de equivalencia) apply only to certain retailers and small traders; no general exemption threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory B2B e-invoicing is phased in under Ley 18/2022 (Crea y Crece), requiring interoperable electronic invoices in structured formats (Facturae or equivalent) and communication to AEAT; full compliance deadlines are pending ministerial development. Immediate Supply of Information (SII) is currently compulsory for large enterprises (turnover over EUR 6,000,000), VAT groups, and businesses in the export/import logistics registration (REDEME); certified software and secure API interfaces with AEAT are required. Traditional paper invoices remain unlawful for covered taxable persons once the e-invoicing mandate enters into force.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods to third countries or territories outside the EU are zero-rated under article 21 of the Spanish VAT Law, provided the goods are physically transferred into a non-EU destination and the exporter can prove departure within the statutory shipping window (generally within 90 days from dispatch). Laboratory testing services physically performed in Spain for non-EU customers are treated as taxable services under the general reverse-charge rules where applicable and are not zero-rated as a matter of export of goods; however, ancillary export-related handling and transport services directly linked to qualifying exported goods may be exempt under article 22 LIVA.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DUA / SAD (Documento Único Administrativo / Single Administrative Document) with export customs exit stamp
Commercial invoice signed by the exporter and the foreign buyer
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR endorsed to the non-EU destination
Proof of foreign-currency or Euro inward payment evidencing actual repatriation of the export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT may retrospectively disallow the zero rate if the documentary evidence is incomplete, goods do not leave the EU within the statutory term, or proceeds are not repatriated within the 180-day economic-control window. Regularization triggers VAT recovery at 21%, late-payment interest, and graduated penalties under articles 191–201 Ley 58/2003 (General Tax Law): negligent understatement from 50% to 100% of the tax evaded, intentional misrepresentation from 100% to 150%, plus potential criminal exposure under article 305 Código Penal where the evaded amount exceeds EUR 120,000 per tax period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain) and, for foreign-investment and capital-movement control, the Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones (DGCOM) of the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Enterprise.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain operates a fully convertible regime under Article 63 TFEU and Law 19/2003; both current-account and capital-account operations are open without prior authorisation. Profit remittances (dividends from an SL) to non-resident shareholders are freely executable via wire transfer once corporate tax filings are up to date and the statutory withholding tax (default 19%; reduced to 5% or 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive for qualifying corporate shareholders) has been settled. There is no foreign-exchange approval gate; only statistical Form BE/C submissions to the Banco de España for transfers exceeding EUR 10,000 and standard AML/CFT verification apply.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or forced conversion exists under Spanish law. Export proceeds may be credited to resident or foreign-currency accounts without conversion to EUR. The SL must nonetheless file the applicable Banco de España balance-of-payments statistical return (Form BO) when a single operation equals or exceeds EUR 1,000,000 (or such cumulative threshold as the Banco de España may set) and must retain invoicing, customs documentation, and bank credit notices for a minimum of five years for tax, treasury, and audit purposes.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: HIGH for EU/EEA-licensed electronic money institutions (e.g., Wise Europe, Revolut) which passport into Spain under the PSD2/EMD2 regime and may open a multi-currency business account with a Spanish IBAN. LOW for offshore or non-EEA EMIs: they are not authorised as Spanish payment institutions, cannot lawfully maintain a live EUR account for an SL, and would require a licensed Spanish/EU intermediary in the payment chain; relying on an unsupervised offshore EMI would breach the Spanish Payment Services Law and the Bank of Spain's supervisory expectations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, tier-1 banks require at least one natural-person director or legal representative with a NIE to appear physically at a Spanish branch to execute the account mandate and confirm ultimate beneficial ownership. The requirement can be fulfilled for non-resident directors by a Spanish notarised power of attorney, though a branch interview will still be expected. Fully remote onboarding is possible only where the director is a Spanish resident and uses a qualified eIDAS certificate and an interoperable video-identification process; non-resident foreign directors should expect in-person or notarised verification and additional source-of-wealth documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner residing in a high-risk or non-EU jurisdiction (e.g., certain Latin American countries).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier: notarised passport/NIE copies of the UBO; Registro Mercantil certificate and shareholding/participaciones register evidencing the full chain; a signed UBO declaration; Banco de España beneficial-ownership record where filed; board minutes approving account opening and stating the commercial and treasury rationale.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial equity contribution from outside Spain lacking an established tax and banking footprint.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier: executed capital-increase deed recorded in the Registro Mercantil; source-institution bank reference; investor audited financial statements or credible source-of-wealth documentation; a 3-year treasury forecast for the UN38.3 and CE-RED laboratory; signed letters of intent from future clients; purchase orders for battery drop-testing towers and electromagnetic measurement equipment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border invoice flows inconsistent with an early-stage laboratory model.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier: ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation or a credible accreditation roadmap; testing-service price list; laboratory insurance certificates; commercial contracts with freight forwarders, battery shippers, and foreign clients; a customs trail for incoming battery samples; and a factual explanation of cross-border payment velocity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Name-screening hit on a minority shareholder or counterparty that coincides with a sanctions/PEP listing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier: sanctions-screening output demonstrating no exact legal match; passport and national identity documentation; public registries showing the coincidence; a compliance undertaking not to transact with sanctioned or restricted persons; and, where warranted, a reasoned EU-qualified legal opinion on control and ownership.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All equity injections should be executed by SWIFT MT103 to the Spanish IBAN of the SL, using a precise remittance reference: 'NIF [VAT number] – APORTACIÓN SOCIAL – [deed date]'. For payments exceeding EUR 1,000,000, the beneficiary bank will require proof that the relevant Banco de España balance-of-payments declaration (Form BO) has been lodged and, where applicable, that the DGCOM foreign-investment registration is in order. The bank will also perform a UBO register check and source-of-wealth assessment. The originator bank must include the full legal name of the SL and the underlying corporate purpose in the payment instructions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Within the SEPA area, EUR disbursements clear through TARGET2/RTGS using SEPA Credit Transfer mechanics based on an MT103. For non-EUR supplier payments (USA, China, Korea), the preferred rails are an irrevocable documentary letter of credit under UCP600 (SWIFT MT700) or a direct SWIFT MT103 transfer; for low-value items below EUR 50,000, Wise Business may be used by funding local clearing accounts in the supplier's currency, provided that commercial invoices and customs/export papers are retained for Spanish tax and internal audit purposes.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright currency forwards on EUR/USD and EUR/GBP
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps for USD/EUR commercial liabilities
European-style currency options with premium payment

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) entered into through a Spanish credit institution to hedge exposure to non-convertible emerging-market currencies, subject to the existence of an underlying commercial exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalization of accounting books and corporate minute book
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the financial year-end; normally by 30 April for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry rejection, potential evidentiary limitations, and administrative penalties where applicable; no automatic strike-off solely for late book legalization

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of annual accounts by the shareholders
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' meeting; no separate filing authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the financial year-end; normally by 30 June for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Director liability risk, possible registry filing delay, and potential administrative sanctions for breach of corporate and accounting obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after shareholder approval; normally by 31 July for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry closure to further filings after one year of non-filing, with fines generally ranging from approximately EUR 1,200 to EUR 60,000 and higher limits for larger entities

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry through the annual accounts filing and, where applicable, the Central Register of Beneficial Ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed with the annual accounts; beneficial ownership changes must be updated without undue delay and within applicable statutory reporting periods
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Filing restrictions, AML compliance deficiencies, possible fines under Spanish anti-money-laundering legislation, and liability for inaccurate or outdated information

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 calendar days following the six-month period after financial year-end; normally 1 to 25 July for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties, late-payment interest, surcharges, and possible tax inspection or assessment

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT summary return, Modelo 390, where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally filed from 1 to 30 January following the calendar year, subject to applicable filing exemptions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties and possible tax inspection; filing may be unnecessary for taxpayers qualifying for the relevant exemption

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent audit is generally mandatory when the company exceeds at least two of the following thresholds for two consecutive financial years: total assets above EUR 2.85 million, annual net turnover above EUR 5.7 million, or average employees above 50. Additional mandatory-audit rules apply to regulated, public-interest, listed, or specially regulated entities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Spanish GAAP). IFRS is generally mandatory for consolidated accounts of listed groups and may apply in other specifically regulated circumstances.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL must maintain its Libro Registro de Socios and update it for share transfers and ownership changes. The annual accounts filing must include the declaration of the real beneficial owner, normally reconfirming the existing information or reporting changes. Beneficial ownership changes must also be reflected in applicable AML registers and corporate records.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Libro Registro de Socios (Register of Members)
Accounting books and annual accounts records
Register or records of directors and corporate appointments maintained consistently with the Commercial Registry

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,500-6,000 for a small non-regulated SL; higher for threshold-triggered, complex, or regulated laboratory operations

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D tax credits (up to 25% of eligible expenses), innovation/digitalization incentives, and regional tax reliefs

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 - Annual Corporate Income Tax Return, filed electronically via AEAT (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria) portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 25 days after the end of the tax year (fiscal year-end)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Base taxable income after revenue and expense adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents report solely Spanish-source income; permanent establishment income reported on Form 210

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: R&D, innovation, and other statutory deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents limited to Spanish-source deductions only

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: 100 euros per day of delay (maximum 1,500 euros); 0.5% of unpaid tax per month of delay

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit Treaty Relief Certificate (TRC) to AEAT via electronic portal; obtain confirmation prior to dividend payment
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 19%; Interest: 19% (reduced to 0-10% under applicable DTAs)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: 20 million euros annual turnover for local file; 50 million euros group turnover for master file
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain transposed EU Economic Substance Directive; requires adequate operational substance for IP holding, financing, and distribution activities to avoid CFC/GAAR challenges

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsification of accounts or deliberate omission of taxable income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties: fines up to 100% of evaded tax plus imprisonment up to 5 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable; possible disqualification, fines, and criminal prosecution

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare TP documentation or application of non-arm's length pricing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to 5% of annual turnover; tax reassessment and interest
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Joint and several liability for unpaid taxes; potential criminal liability in aggravated cases

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to withhold and remit WHT on dividends, royalties, or interest paid to non-residents
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines equal to 100% of unpaid WHT plus interest on late payment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for the tax, penalties, and interest
